keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Brand names, product names, people or phrases to watch. Each is searched as an exact phrase.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Where to look. Telegram needs a channel list below (it has no public global search).

telegramChannels.title: Telegram channels (for the telegram source)
telegramChannels.description: Public channel handles to watch for your keywords, e.g. durov or t.me/durov.

newsLanguage.title: News language
newsLanguage.description: Google News interface language, e.g. en-US, de, pt-BR.

newsCountry.title: News country
newsCountry.description: Google News edition country code, e.g. US, GB, DE, BR, IN.

maxPerKeywordPerSource.title: Max mentions per keyword per source

maxRows.title: Max rows per run
maxRows.description: Cap on mention rows returned. Controls total cost.

dedupe.title: Only new mentions (alert feed)
dedupe.description: Remember seen mentions across runs and emit only new ones. Keep on with a schedule; turn off for a one-time backfill sweep.
